Due to the strategic importance of aviation in meeting societal and economic needs, Europe’s key stakeholders have developed visions for 2020 (Vision 2020) and towards 2050 (FlightPath 2050) [2]
Already by 2020 [3] it is expected that aircraft will be significantly more affordable, safer, cleaner and quieter than at the turn of the century
